verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh ek mek rom mahimaa ana(n)t agam apaar gur mahimaa nidhaan hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of inexhaustible toil of Naam Simran in the service of a True Guru, the praise of a hair of a Gursikh is infinite. Then the inaccessible Satguru with countless virtues is a treasure house of praises.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਬੋਲ ਕੋ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਮੋਲ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਮਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh ek mek bol ko na tol mol sree gur sabadh agamit giaan dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Those who obey the commands of their True Guru; those who are one with their Guru; their words are beyond evaluation. Then the divine words of a True Guru, his Gyan (knowledge) and reflection on his precepts is beyond comprehension.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਾਰੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਰਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh ek mek dhirasaT dhirasaT taarai sree gur kaTaachh kirapaa ko na paramaan hai ||

en.bdb: When one who is in harmony with True Guru, who meditates on His name, his one glimpse is good enough to sail the recipient across the ocean. Then the intensity of power of a True Guru is incomprehensible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਪਲ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੭੩॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh ek mek pal sa(n)g ra(n)g ras abigat gat satigur nirabaan hai ||73||

en.bdb: The company of a person for a second, who is deep into the meditation of Lord's name bless one with happiness, ecstasy and elixir of life. Like indestructible Lord, Satguru  is an epitome of eternal bliss. (73)
